steps.reason: feature-staging.yml and docs-site.yml write each composed IG's own bibliography page (owner, 2026-11-03, bean djj5) into ./_docs/<instance>/, which the IG compose step builds only in those jobs: a WRITE of a page, not a check of the tree. Its logic is pinned by folio-assistant-core's bibliography-page tests in `bun test`.

feature-staging.yml hashes the preview it just built into its build record (folio-assistant#2881; owner Q-SPD-9 B, Q-SPD-9b A, 2026-11-01). Its input is the built ./_site, which exists only in the staging job: a WRITE of a record, not a check of the tree. Its logic is pinned by preview-record.test.ts in `bun test`.

feature-staging.yml's verify mode compares an agent-built preview's record (read from gh-pages) with the full CI rebuild of the same tree (folio-assistant#2881). Both records exist only in that job. Its logic is pinned by preview-record.test.ts in `bun test`.

health-check.yml writes the daily health report to its state branch (cat/cat-harness/health on THIS repository: `health` is `scope: "repository"`, owner 2026-10-23, bean kyrg; owner, 2026-10-11: "move health to state branch now") from a contents: write job: a WRITE, not a check, with no tree to judge. The splice it performs is pinned by state-push.test.ts in `bun test`.

health-check.yml adds the daily pages-serving observation (bean 1dre, folio-assistant#2538) to this commit's qa-reports entry from a contents: write job: a WRITE of a network observation into a branch, not a check, with no tree to judge, like qa:prune. Its add-only rule (never changes the entry's first write) is pinned by qa-store.test.ts in `bun test`.

docs-site.yml's dependency-cone dry run (bean fwtz, folio-assistant#2647; `$S` is cat-harness-tools/scripts/docs-cone-dryrun.ts): `inputs` diffs the commit the LIVE site was built from (the gh-pages checkout's `pages/build.json`) and its recorded branch-mount tips against this deploy, so its inputs exist only in the deploy job. A measurement logged beside the deploy (continue-on-error), never a verdict on the tree; its logic is pinned by docs-cone-dryrun.test.ts in `bun test`.

docs-site.yml's dependency-cone dry run (bean fwtz, folio-assistant#2647; `$S` is cat-harness-tools/scripts/docs-cone-dryrun.ts): `judge` compares the BUILT `_site` with the published gh-pages root and writes the verdict to the step summary, so it needs both trees, which exist only in the deploy job. A measurement logged beside the deploy (continue-on-error), never a verdict on the tree; its logic is pinned by docs-cone-dryrun.test.ts in `bun test`.

repin-train.yml's skip decision (issue #2873, owner card Q-SPD-3 B): it reads this repository's open and closed train PRs and their commit statuses through the GitHub API to decide whether a new train opens, so its inputs exist only in that scheduled job. A decision about PRs, never a verdict on the tree; its logic is pinned by test/workflows/repin-train.test.ts in `bun test`.

repin-train-verdict.yml's no-new-failures status (issue #2873, owner card Q-SPD-3 B): it compares the check runs GitHub reported on a train head with those on main and WRITES a commit status and PR comment, so its inputs exist only after those runs finish. A write about other checks' results, never a verdict on the tree; its logic is pinned by test/workflows/repin-train.test.ts in `bun test`.
